p1.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft-finished knit with a knitted-in jacquard design; adult sizes are 100% acrylic.
  • Family story: One cozy Christmas sweater for mom, dad, and the kids, made for tree trimming, holiday parties, Christmas morning, and family photos.
  • Print: Reindeer String Lights shows a smiling cartoon reindeer with a red nose, a red hat, and a striped scarf, its antlers wrapped in red, green, and white string lights, set on navy with white snowflakes above a white band of green trees and deer. The lights are part of the knit pattern, with no electronics.
  • Design details: Long-sleeve pullover with a crew neckline, tree-and-deer bands on the sleeves, navy ribbed cuffs and hem, and a relaxed, loose fit.
  • Care: Wash gently in cold water and lay flat to dry to keep the knit soft and in shape.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 6-7 Years, and unisex Adult S through Adult 3XL.

Reindeer String Lights dresses the whole family in the same navy holiday sweater, in child sizes and unisex adult sizes for mom and dad. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching family look you need.

Measurements are garment measurements in centimeters; chest is the full chest circumference, and child heights are the suggested wearer height. Hip and waist measurements are unavailable, and the chart gives no weight guidance, so check child height first and compare the chest, sleeve, and garment-length measurements with a sweater that fits well. Hand measuring can vary by 1-3 cm.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Christmas sweater in child sizes plus unisex adult sizes.
  • String-light reindeer design: A cheerful reindeer tangled in knitted string lights, framed by snowflakes and a band of green trees.
  • Soft jacquard knit: A soft-finished jacquard knit for fall and winter gatherings; adult sizes are 100% acrylic.
  • Relaxed pullover: A loose-cut crew-neck pullover with long sleeves and navy ribbed trim.
  • Family size range: Five child sizes and six adult sizes; see the size chart for measurements.

Choose the sizes you need for a cozy Reindeer String Lights family photo.

p2.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Adult sweaters are a soft 100% acrylic knit; kids' sweaters are a soft 71.7% viscose, 28.3% polyester knit. Both are medium weight with a slight stretch and a knitted-in jacquard design.
  • Family story: One classic Christmas sweater for mom, dad, and the kids, made for tree trimming, holiday parties, Christmas morning, and family photos.
  • Print: Nordic Reindeer knits a row of white reindeer and snowflakes across a bright red chest, framed by navy wave bands with white snowflakes and bands of small navy trees and white dots.
  • Design details: Long-sleeve pullover with a crew neckline, ribbed red cuffs and hem, and the Nordic pattern repeated on the sleeves.
  • Care: Wash gently in cold water and lay flat to dry to keep the knit soft and in shape.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 6-7 Years, and unisex Adult XXS through Adult 3XL.
